description: Source code for LoadBalancerEncoder class implementing connection ID generation and configuration management in QUIC load balancing.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoder
classes.description: Class responsible for encoding load balancer connection IDs, managing configurations, and generating connection IDs in QUIC load balancing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a LoadBalancerEncoder instance with validation of unroutable connection ID length.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the load balancer configuration and server ID, initializes nonce seed, and notifies visitor of changes.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes current configuration and notifies visitor.

methods.name: GenerateConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a new connection ID based on current configuration, nonce, and encryption status.

methods.name: GenerateNextConnectionId
methods.description: Generates the next connection ID, with restrictions based on encoding and encryption.

methods.name: MaybeReplaceConnectionId
methods.description: Decides whether to replace a connection ID based on version and length.

methods.name: ConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Determines the length of a connection ID from the first byte.

methods.name: MakeUnroutableConnectionId
methods.description: Creates an unroutable connection ID with random bytes.
